item.title: Casper is a man of focus, commitment & sheer will. :)
item.description: Casper is a Great Pyrenees from Decatur, Georgia. he was only 20 months old when a pack of 11 coyotes came for his pregnant partner Daisy and the sheep flock he guards he killed 3 coyotes inside the pen, then jumped a 4 foot fence and went after the rest. by the end he’d taken out 8 of the 11 he vanished for two days after. His owners believed he was tracking the rest to finish the job. They found him with a chunk of skin torn off and injuries so bad the vet didn’t think he’d make it. he survived multiple surgeries and lost his tail. It was a miracle he survived. a year later he was nominated for Farm Dog of the Year and won the People’s Choice Pup award with over 100,000 votes he’s back on the farm today, fully retired from active duty, still getting his Wendy’s hamburgers as a reward good boy doesn’t even begin to cover it source: American Farm Bureau / Fox 5 Atlanta

item.description: https://nypost.com/2026/07/31/us-news/jeanine-pirro-seeks-to-drop-charges-against-olympian-david-hearn-admits-reflecting-pool-damage-was-flawed-installation/?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=nypost : 'The July 31 court filing reveals that the sealant at the bottom of the Reflecting Pool had “[a]lmost immediately” begun peeling after the work was completed after the Virginia-based company got a no-bid contract for the renovations. "The Trump administration’s case against Davey Hearn should never have been brought. Its dismissal today does not erase the abuse of government power in arresting and charging a patriotic American who did nothing wrong. The government’s approach was ready, fire, aim. The administration owes Mr. Hearn an apology," said Hearn’s attorneys Norm Eisen, Mary Dohrmann and Steve Levin in a statement. Reps for DOI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.' Also in the article it says that in their court filing they try to claim that "DOI’s failure to fully and accurately provide information to USAODC undermined the government’s ability to" evaluate the evidence before the indictment. So, throwing the Department of the Interior under the bus to excuse their pathetic incompetence in carrying out a character assassination and vindictive prosecution.
